#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    int ans = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < str.length()) {
        int count = 1;
        while (i + count < str.length() && str[i + count] == str[i]) {
            count++;
        }
        if (count % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i += count;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
